notes.title: March 14, 2025 - Game Update Details + Save File Compatibility Notice
notes.notes:
Hello, this is GomPangGames.
On March 14, 2025, we are releasing an update to enhance the overall gameplay experience.
Please check the details below.

[b]<Update Details>[/b]
1. Some puzzles have been adjusted to improve the natural flow of gameplay.
(Developer’s Comment)
Some existing puzzles were found to be somewhat unintuitive or unnatural.
To provide a smoother gameplay experience, we have made adjustments to certain puzzles.

2. Certain scenes that were excessively gory or could cause discomfort without significant meaning have been modified or removed to improve the overall user experience.
(Developer’s Comment)
While some players appreciated these elements, we determined that they could be unpleasant for a broader audience.
To enhance the overall completeness of the game and make it enjoyable for more players, we decided that modifying these elements was the best approach.
We sincerely apologize to those who enjoyed these aspects of the game.

[b]<Save File Compatibility Notice>[/b]
Due to modifications to some puzzles and in-game sequences, save data from the previous version will no longer be compatible.
As a result, even if you have an existing save file, the game will start from the beginning after the update.
Although this was a necessary step to improve the game, we sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused by the loss of previous save data.
We will continue to improve the game to provide a better gameplay experience in the future.
We kindly ask for your understanding, and once again, we sincerely apologize.

3) Some source code has been modified and added for mobile integration, but it does not affect gameplay.(It must not affect gameplay...)

notes.title: Microscope Puzzle Skip Feature and New Achievement Added
notes.notes:
I've realized that the microscope puzzle has been more challenging than I initially intended for many players. I don't want anyone to abandon the entire game just because they're stuck on a single puzzle at the beginning, or to lose their interest in the game after spending too much time on it. Therefore, I've decided to add a feature that allows players who are struggling with this puzzle to skip it.

However, I understand that this solution might diminish the sense of accomplishment for players who solve the puzzle on their own. To balance this, I've introduced a special achievement that can only be earned by solving the puzzle without using the skip option.

If you have any further questions or suggestions about the game, please don't hesitate to reach out to me via developer email or on the Steam discussion boards. I'll do my best to respond as quickly as possible. Thank you for your understanding and support.
